rule: Order: wind-up swish (prepareHit) -> hit key -> C++ raw damage (min + (max-min)*strength) -> Lua onHit when successful: armour (damage, condition, skill, armour sound), difficulty, Health Damage sound, blood at hit position, stagger roll (agility term vs raw damage, plus 0-99 roll) -> knockdown or hit recovery. Victim lock lasts the hit animation clip (no timer). A handler returning false stops later handlers.
keep: Ordered on-hit chain: sound, blood, stagger as separate steps
Handler returning false stops later handlers
One attack record for every hit
Stagger as its own roll, separate from damage
Lock length tied to the hit clip
change: Move the stagger roll from the victim's local script to the engine (server-verified state)
Client presents knockdown or recovery from the event; never rolls it
Add hit stop, shake and flash (client only); donor has none
Lock length from data per family, not only the clip
Many-on-one: a hit runs the chain once; stagger must not stack a longer lock per hit
look_test: Phone, 375 wide, one hero vs one creature. Three builds behind a style flag: A donor-like (swish, hit sound, blood, recovery); B A plus server-decided knockdown; C B plus 60 ms freeze, 2 px shake, 80 ms white flash. Dom judges which reads as a landed hit without hiding the next attack, three fights each.
